title: Face Sculpt #114 (일본 · 아이돌 · 귀여운 · 양쪽 트임 8배+거대한 눈 · 성형 코 1단 · 둥근 베이비 페이스 · 정면 · 메이크업 비주얼계 블랙립 5단계 · 극한 · P50(화려) · 귀 추 9개/귀 2구멍 · 엄니(금) 패턴C · 렌즈 오드아이 터쿼이즈(고양이눈)|크림슨 레드(둥근 동공))
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the middle of her chest, the frame cutting off there, so the weights and chains fully hang in view. Her face is large and sharp. Early 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult Japanese woman — Japanese pop idol visual luminous fair porcelain complexion with a neutral-rose undertone and clear glass-skin glow, early 20s, hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most dramatic hourglass ratio ever, simultaneously maximum enormous bust AND maximum enormous hips both flaring to absolute impossible extremes while the waist is cinched to impossible minimum, soft chestnut-brown long waves with curtain bangs. Real pores and fine skin grain on her skin, a soft sheen of natural oils, large eyes with bright real catchlights, full lips, pushed to the absolute extreme: heavily smudged black eyeshadow blazing from the lash line up to the temples, thick smeared black liner all around the eyes, clumped black lashes top and bottom, fully opaque saturated jet-black lips, deeply shadowed black contour under the cheekbones, odd-eyed with two clearly different lenses: her left eye has a bright turquoise coloured contact lens with a vertical slit cat-eye pupil, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, and her right eye has an intense crimson-red coloured contact lens with round natural pupils, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, sitting naturally on the irises and clear of the eyelids, the two eye colours both bright and clearly different from each other, wide bright eyes, cheeks lifted by a playful half-smile with a hint of teeth, a cute, playful expression — a photograph of a real Japanese woman's face (East Asian Japanese features: a soft rounded short face with full cheeks and a small delicate chin, small narrow monolid eyes set slightly wide apart with no crease, a low soft nose bridge with a rounded tip, small modest lips, soft low flat eyebrows), not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light  Her face has been surgically sculpted far beyond her natural look, and these changes override her natural features: her eyes are the star of her face (the shape, size and lenses described here override the eyes of her makeup, while the colours of her eyeshadow and liner follow her makeup): pure fantasy eyes, impossibly long, wide open and gigantic yet elegantly beautiful, with both corners opened to the extreme: the inner corners are cut open so far that they almost meet at the root of her nose, the small pink inner corners clearly visible on either side of the nose bridge, and the outer corners sweep across her temples, past her ears and into the hairline at the side of her head, so each eye opening is about eight times its natural length and also far taller and rounder than normal, two colossal, wide-open, long almond-shaped eyes with high arched upper lids running almost the whole width of her face, each filled with a huge round iris in the middle and a clean sweep of white on both sides, so the eyes look overwhelmingly bigger, not just longer, still graceful, perfectly symmetrical and beautiful; a razor-sharp black liner follows the entire shape and ends in a very long, fine point swept up into her hair above each ear; the eyes are in very large coloured doll-eye contact lenses with a glossy shine and a big iris, both eyes the same, with a round natural pupil and bright catchlights; her nose: a high, straight, refined, surgically sculpted nose: a tall, slim, straight bridge, a narrow, pointed, projecting tip and clearly narrow nostril wings with slim, neat nostrils; her jawline and chin: a soft, round 'baby face' jaw: full, plump, rounded cheeks, a short, soft, rounded jawline with no sharp angles and a small, round, slightly full chin. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque.

Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about forty-one in total (not counting the hanging weights), spread over every area so that no area is empty: a single thick, solid, sharp tusk of polished solid yellow gold with a warm mirror finish and a slender sharp taper as thick as her thumb in the middle passes straight through the lower part of the septum, the thin soft wall between the nostrils, and sweeps out sideways just beneath her nostril wings, only as far as their outer edges and not one bit further, in a short, smooth boar-tusk curve, its two ends rising clearly upward and tapering to needle-sharp points, the tips ending far below her eyes at the height of her nostrils; the tusk sits clearly above her upper lip and does not touch or cover her lips; nothing hangs from the tusk; one small ring wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; two small hoop or studs along the edge of the upper lip; four small hoop or studs across the lower lip's edge; one thick, heavy iron ring as wide as a large coin through the skin of the chin, just beneath her lower lip, and from the bottom of this one chin ring hang three separate massive solid weights of rough black cast iron, each on its own thick, heavy chain of black iron links of a different length, hanging side by side down along her chin and throat onto her neck and chest: a squat solid cube-shaped block, a solid rough cannonball and a chunky solid hexagonal block; each weight is as big as a fist or larger, dense, solid and blunt with no thin parts, and the chains are pulled bar-straight and taut, and her lips stay fully bare and visible; on each ear, two separate large healed openings in the earlobe, one below the other with a clear gap of bare skin between them, each opening holding its own very thick, heavy black cast-iron ring as thick as a finger, a plain solid ring with no open tunnel, and above them sit seven pieces above the lobe: four classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim, two studs and small bars across the upper cartilage and one in the conch and tragus; five small studs across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; four small studs along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. The left and right sides are balanced. The pieces are spread over the whole face in clear rows so every one reads individually, with bare skin between them; the eyes and eyelids stay clear.  All the ear weights hang from the bottoms of these two iron rings, and they are not counted in the piercing total: on each ear there are exactly nine separate massive solid weights, each of a different shape: on the left ear a solid rough boulder-like lump on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid rough cube-shaped block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid thick rectangular ingot block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a thick solid disc like a weight plate on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a small solid kettlebell with a thick short handle on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid rough cannonball on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a short thick solid cylinder stump on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid squat hammer head block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid pyramid-shaped lump with a wide base on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links; on the right ear a solid rough cube-shaped block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid rough boulder-like lump on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid rough cannonball on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a short thick solid cylinder stump on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid thick rectangular ingot block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid squat hammer head block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid pyramid-shaped lump with a wide base on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a thick solid disc like a weight plate on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a small solid kettlebell with a thick short handle on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links. On each ear the two iron rings each carry their own column of weights, the two columns holding 5 and 4 weights, hanging side by side on chains of different lengths and staggered at different heights so every weight is fully visible and none hides another. Every single weight is an enormous, dense, completely solid, squat, blunt lump of rough black cast iron, as big as a fist or larger, with no thin parts, no arms and no hollow parts; its size does NOT shrink just because there are many of them: the last weight is exactly as big, as thick and as heavy-looking as the first. Each weight alone looks like it weighs several kilograms, each chain is pulled bar-straight and taut, and at a glance every single one looks crushingly, unmistakably heavy, the long chains reaching down along her neck to her collarbones. Because the load is shared between two openings, each earlobe is stretched only into a firm, moderately long, healthy loop of skin that hangs just past her jaw; the lobe does not sag, droop, collapse or hang down to her shoulder, her head stays upright, and the skin stays smooth and intact, fully healed, with no tearing, no wound, no blood and no redness. The face and ear jewelry is real mixed yellow gold, silver and rose gold set with glossy multicoloured enamel and rainbow gemstones, the tusk and its rings are real polished solid yellow gold, while the connector ring, the chains and all the hanging weights are always black cast iron, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Hair: her hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, her jawline and her neck fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
